test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A shopkeeper offers the following two discount schemes.

A) Buy 3 get 4 free

B) Buy 5 get 6 free

Which scheme has the maximum discount percentage?

options.text: A does not give any discount
A and B both have the same discount percentage

solution:
**Formula used:**

Effective discount = x + y - (x × y)/100

effective discount = (Article get free)/(Total articles) × 100
